title: Customer Sentiment Analysis
description: Architected an end-to-end NLP and multi-target classification system to analyze raw customer feedback, predict sentiment polarities, flag automated complaint registrations, and forecast issue resolution probability. Engineered text preprocessing and vectorization pipelines using TF-IDF and N-gram tokenization, followed by systematic benchmarking across 6 supervised classification algorithms (Logistic Regression, KNN, Decision Tree, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, and XGBoost). Implemented cross-validation, hyperparameter tuning, and classification metric evaluations (F1-score, precision-recall trade-offs) while deploying an interactive Streamlit inference engine with dynamic Plotly visualizations for granular review diagnosis.
tools: Python, Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, Pandas, NumPy, NLTK, TF-IDF, Feature Engineering, Plotly, Streamlit, Git

title: Dynamic Pricing: Ride Cost Prediction
description: Developed a dynamic pricing and regression modeling engine to forecast ride fares based on spatio-temporal variables, route duration, demand surge indicators, and vehicle categories. Designed automated data cleaning pipelines, categorical encoding schemes, and feature transformation workflows to capture non-linear relationships. Trained and benchmarked multiple regression algorithms to minimize RMSE and MAE, evaluating cost drivers through feature importance metrics. Deployed a low-latency interactive Streamlit application powered by real-time Plotly cost breakdowns to simulate dynamic fare estimations.
tools: Python, Scikit-Learn, Pandas, NumPy, Regression Analysis, Feature Engineering, Plotly, Streamlit, Git

title: HR Employee Attrition Prediction
description: Engineered a predictive talent analytics system to classify employee turnover risks and isolate critical organizational attrition triggers. Implemented robust feature preprocessing, addressing target class skewness through stratified cross-validation and rigorous feature selection across demographic and workplace performance metrics. Benchmarked 6 supervised classification algorithms with comprehensive ROC-AUC, Precision-Recall, and confusion matrix diagnostics to isolate the optimal model. Integrated an interactive Streamlit diagnostic console equipped with Plotly ROC curve visualizations to empower proactive HR retention interventions.
tools: Python, Scikit-Learn, Pandas, NumPy, Classification Modeling, ROC-AUC Analysis, Feature Engineering, Plotly, Streamlit, Git

title: Loan Approval Prediction
description: Built a credit risk classification pipeline to evaluate financial applicant profiles and automate loan eligibility determinations. Formulated disciplined preprocessing pipelines with numerical imputation, scaling, and categorical one-hot encoding, analyzing feature correlations where credit score emerged as the primary decision signal. Evaluated a 6-algorithm machine learning benchmark, optimizing a Random Forest ensemble to achieve ~0.99 ROC-AUC with minimal false-positive loan default rates. Deployed the scoring engine into a secure, interactive Streamlit production UI featuring interactive Plotly decision audits.
tools: Python, Scikit-Learn, Ensemble Modeling, Random Forest, Pandas, NumPy, Hyperparameter Tuning, Plotly, Streamlit, Git

title: Telco Customer Churn Prediction
description: Formulated a telecom churn forecasting solution to detect early subscription cancellations across tenure and contractual dimensions. Constructed clean statistical feature transformation pipelines, evaluating customer lifecycle signals, billing structures, and service enrollments. Conducted an empirical comparison across 6 classification algorithms, tuning a Random Forest model that achieved an ~0.84 ROC-AUC benchmark with high recall on churned customer segments. Delivered an operational Streamlit web platform with interactive Plotly visual analytics for cohort risk profiling.
tools: Python, Scikit-Learn, Random Forest, Pandas, NumPy, Feature Engineering, Churn Modeling, Plotly, Streamlit, Git

title: Housing Price Prediction
description: Constructed an end-to-end real estate valuation and regression system to estimate residential property valuations from complex structural and spatial attributes. Executed rigorous outlier trimming, missing value imputations, log transformations for skewed price targets, and engineered interaction terms across living space and property features. Benchmarked regularized regression models alongside tree-based ensembles, optimizing for minimal RMSE and maximized R-squared scores. Deployed a dynamic Streamlit estimation dashboard with interactive multi-attribute Plotly visualizations for instant valuation inferences.
tools: Python, Scikit-Learn, Pandas, NumPy, Regression Analysis, Feature Engineering, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly, Streamlit, Git

title: Customer Churn Intelligence Platform
description: Architected an end-to-end predictive machine learning platform to forecast customer attrition and identify at-risk accounts in real time. Designed automated data preprocessing pipelines, statistical feature selection, and domain-driven feature engineering to handle class imbalance and behavioral signals. Trained, tuned, and evaluated supervised classification algorithms (including XGBoost, LightGBM, and Random Forest), tracking performance via ROC-AUC, Precision-Recall curves, and F1-score. Integrated SHAP and LIME for explainable AI (XAI) to interpret model decisions and identify primary churn drivers. Deployed the trained model artifacts behind high-throughput REST APIs and an interactive Streamlit dashboard for real-time inference and proactive retention strategy execution.
tools: Python, Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, Pandas, NumPy, Feature Engineering, SHAP, Model Evaluation, Hyperparameter Tuning, FastAPI, Streamlit, Git

By leveraging data visualization and analytical techniques, actionable insights were generated to support strategic business decisions and improve sales performance. This project demonstrates the ability to analyze commercial datasets and extract meaningful recommendations from data..
